reviews.review_description: Love that Supernatural has made a comeback! Way to set an amazing example showing that even when the world thinks you're out, you can come back, stronger than ever! Thank you to the coaches and everyone else who serves as part of the pit crew :)

So excited for this day! We’ve all been (not so) patiently waiting for the team to come back and start creating again!! I’ll be keeping the legacy edition until we get Together on the new one but I’m so incredibly excited and proud of the supernatural team and community!!
Much love always!!!

I loved the old supernatural, and I’m SO EXCITED that it’s back! 

Supernatural has become a core part of my workout routine, and I’m pumped to have a new series of workouts to do, alongside familiar faces like coaches Raneir and Leanne

This app changed the way I see workouts- thanks for helping me reach my fitness goals!

Supernatural has been the only workout I’ve ever been able to stick to and enjoy!!! I’m so glad it’s back! If you want to get a workout in, but not feel like you’re working out-you need this!!! The coach’s are all awesome and there’s also a wonderful, supportive community! LOVE the wide variety of music and the beautiful views!

Much awaited!! Our family is back and looking AMAZING!!
Now it's time to get to work laugh cry, and share stories about our boxing and flow sessions all while growing and getting stronger!
We got this fam; we have diamonds waiting for us 😁💎💎💎 
NOW LET’S GOOOOO 🎉🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎊🎊🎊🎊🎊💎💎

reviews.review_title: It’s back!! And Better than ever
reviews.review_description: Love the new look and the toturials in the beginning good refresh the fast feet always got me. Had a great time playing ever since it came into my life. Newly improved inticipating its launch and finally now an hr  and half later still wanting to push thru but got a headache  lol only think I signed in with my account on meta and didn’t transfer anything going thru the steps to see for adding it back but still trying it says I’m new and that’s no points 😢 dead lol  but loved every min of it.

I jumped back in with both feet, swollen joints and all! At 61, I have all kinds of chronic pain from fibromyalgia and hypermobile connective tissues. 

Moving makes me feel better and Supernatural helps ME!!

I love dancing to great music and so many of my favorite songs 🎵 and routines are back!!

Get moving! There's a discount if you join now!!!

If you have never done Supernatural before, be warned: once you start, you can’t stop. This group of coaches, choreographers and developers has changed so many lives! The physical and mental health benefits are endless. You will want to workout every day for the first time in your life!

So happy to have this back in my life. Did not realize how much I missed the coaches and the community. This an amazing app. You will catch yourself smiling and laughing while sweating! Can not say enough  good things about supernatural. Treat yourself to this and your family as well. Do it athlete!

So happy to be in early access with the new App. Such hard work to make it available so soon! Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I really enjoyed the welcome workout. I was easily able to transfer my data. I was wondering if there is anyway in the future you can transfer the check marks that tell us that we have already done the workout in the past?

Supernatural is literally the ONLY reason I have a VR headset! Thank you for figuring out how to make working out at home so much fun and actually effective. The variety of workouts, great music, amazing scenery, and coaching styles keep me coming back for more. No matter how little time or skill you have, there are workouts for everyone here. I became a Supernatural member over 3 years ago and it's one of the best things I've done for myself and will continue to do.  If you're contemplating, you need to give it a try. TOTALLY WORTH IT!!! Thank you Supernatural Team!

I am so glad to be able to continue my Supernatural journey with the only exercise that keeps me motivated to do it daily. I recommend this for anyone looking for a workout with variety that can be modified based on your own capabilities. Come join the fun while working on your health!

Just as great as last time I tried it, I am so happy this app and the coaches are back! A sinple 8 min test run had me smiling and working out in a way most other apps just dont quite do for me. 
Love that its back, give it a try and prepare to get hooked!

Supernatural is the best fitness app. I’ve tried a few others and none compare. Since I discovered this app 2 yrs ago, I have never tired of it or been bored. So much fun and a great workout. I’ve lost weight and gained muscle while having fun!! Thank you coaches for bringing this back!

reviews.review_title: Yes ! So happy it's back.  AND better !
reviews.review_description:
Was so happy to get the email.

Couldn't wait to try.


Took a break from work, found most of my workouts 
still there.

Started a workout.

Better graphics.
Same interface.

Thank you Supernatural team !

The  best VR workout by a long mile--and I'd say the best workout period--is back and is as excellent as ever. If you're looking for a great workout in the privacy of your own space, this is the one to get. The moves planned by kinesiology are there and the coaching is perfect. You'll get hooked day 1.

reviews.review_title: S T O K E D 💪 🥊
reviews.review_description: Can’t wait to get back in headset and sneak workouts in between family obligations. Relaunched just in time for winter and all the other things that wreck my workout consistency without SN. LFG!

There was a little bit of a lag and height issue for me when I was calibrating the game but I got out and came back in and was able to calibrate it correctly.  Other than that it's like the Legacy game but  a little better.  It's like they worked out the kinks from the legacy app.  Can't wait for it to grow

reviews.review_title: I’m so excited!! OMG - Wow! I love it.
reviews.review_description: I can’t wait to get on and try it!! I just transferred all my point and workouts! I already paid for my my first years founding member fee. I’m ready to get going.  I just did a flow workout and a boxing session and it was great. Beautiful scenery and the music rocks, coaches are still amazing as usual. I am so GRATEFUL AND HAPPY that Supernatural is back and better than ever.  Can’t wait to see the custom bats for the founders. Thank you, thank you, thank you to the coaches and everyone behind the scenes who made this possible! ✝️♥️

So glad Supernatural is back! Most of my favourite workouts were waiting for me, and the transfer was quick and painless. The new environments look great, and I'm looking forward to regular new content. I've missed that.

Congratulations to everyone involved. As a founder whose startup was acquired years ago, I love that you got the chance to take your baby back, give it a hug, feed it, and give it another chance to thrive.

Xxx

reviews.review_title: The absolute best! they are back!!
reviews.review_description: I started a few years ago and it has been huge in my physical and mental health. To be able to exercise in these incredible surroundings to favorite music with amazing coaches is so uplifting. I was devastated when the coaches were gone. I am so elated to have them back!! yay, stay independent. Love you all and appreciate you so much!! this is better than ever!

🎶It’s all in we…anything you want done baby.  
You should be bragging, cause your the ones, we asked you, and you made it done!  🎶
The Supernatural team are Superstars.  
Thank you for keeping the heart of this community beating.  This has become much more than a workout for so many of us.  It’s a community that encourages, sympathizes, relates and connects without judgement or negativity, on a global level.  It’s something to celebrate🥂.

Thanks to Team SN so much for pulling through for the athletes! I've used Supernatural almost every day for over 5 years, with almost 3000 workouts logged in the old app. It literally has saved me from weekly trips to the physical therapist to keep from throwing out my back, plus it gives me great vibes to start the day in spite of my ADHD. I have dozens of fitness apps in headset and on Switch. None of them give me both the same well-rounded workout (swinging bats or boxing) and motivation to keep coming back - from the 360 environments and variety of music to the goofy coaches. And there's lots of customizability. Can't stand Coach Mark's bad jokes? Turn on focus mode. Get VR sick? Make the platform bigger. Can't stand period (or can't squat/lunge/etc)? Use the accessibility settings to adjust so it fits your needs. I know it seems expensive, but I haven't found anything else that comes close. Early access is missing a few of the features from before (like group workouts) but it still has almost library of thousands of coached workouts and all the core features plus some new moves you haven't seen even if you used the old app.

supernatural has helped me develop the confidence and excitement i needed about a exercise. when i'm working out i can't believe that i'm in an environment that's absolutely beautiful and i'm happy to be there. at 61 years old i never thought i would look forward to exercising as much as i do with supernatural i am definitely addicted but it's an addiction i hope to always keep 

thank you to everyone who made it possible for us to have the coaches back and be a part of this new launch it's so exciting

reviews.review_title: Don't think about it, DO IT!
reviews.review_description: If you're ready to invest in your health, your time and effort is well spent here. These people CARE, and they will go the extra mile to make your experience great. I love that Supernatural is back and independent! It makes me want to work as hard as they do. Well... Almost as hard 😆

I absolutely love everything about this app. Fantastic music choices, beautiful scenery, really fun workout choreography, and everything in-between. You can't go wrong with this VR program if you are looking for a great workout and escape from the craziness life brings us daily.

Supernatural legitimately changed my life and my fitness, and I can't be happier that you all are keeping it going with this new app. Just did my first workout in it and it's fantastic right out the gates. Keep up the great work!
I loved the legacy supernatural but you all have done a wonderful job on the new version...mind BLOWN!!!!

Is it just me or does everything in the new Supernatural look shiny and bright?! My face hurts from smiling so much. This app makes me so happy! Thank you to all of the Supernatural Team for coming back and making this spectacular app continue with a family feeling (coaches, interactions on the Facebook page)
!!! 🥰

I love this program and I am thrilled that the founders and coaches were able to buy and relaunch it. It is
 worth every single penny for your health... physical and mental.   I have used it for 4 years now and have rarely missed a day.  It is very enjoyable.

After the rollercoaster of disappointment, resignation, acceptance, then hope, then finally a burst of renewing my faith in the power of people, its now back after months of anticipation! So glad to have the supernatural team and app back in our headsets!!!

got logged in, transferred my data and was excited to see my coaches fresh faces and beautiful smiles! After my summer working out outside, I am back in my headset and ready for the challenges. I must admit i am a bit rusty🥰

reviews.review_title: Most motivating, fun way to work out!
reviews.review_description: I started using Supernatural for exercise when I was recovering from treatment for breast cancer. I love that you can work out as you are, where you are, at whatever time works best. The app is always available. The coaches are great, and so is the community of other Supernatural athletes. The new app has been so anticipated, and there is a lot of excitement that it's here now.

I was so bummed when the news came out that SN was ending. This was the only workout I had ever been consistent with and over two years! My heart really went out to the whole AN team that worked so hard on an amazing app. I was ecstatic when the news broke of the new SN and with all the same coaches! I am so happy everyone is back!

reviews.review_title: The BEST VR workout app is BACK
reviews.review_description:
I have always hated exercising!  I found it boring and going to a gym more trouble than it was worth.  Several years ago, I was diagnosed with diabetes and told that regular exercise would help with my blood sugar.  I discovered Supernatural and have been using it regularly ever since.

It is the only exercise program I have stuck with.  When Meta announced that it was shutting down Supernatural, I was very upset and vowed to keep using it until they turned it off.

Now, with the rebirth of Supernatural with the original crew, I can once again rejoice.

This is the best VR exercise program I have ever used!  I recommend it to anyone who needs to get off their butt and exercise.

Was anxious about whether the new Supernatural would be nearly as good as the legacy version, and now I am SO HAPPY with how it turned out! 🌟 

Some features are to be added later, but honestly the current Early Access version meets most of my needs already. It is thrilling to be back in the headset with "my coaches" doing new workouts, with access to many of my old favorites too. 

And the crispy new definition on the landscapes is an added bonus. Wow, STRONG WORK Supernatural Team!! 👏
I’ve been waiting for this day for quite some time now. Can’t wait to get into the headset and get active!
Other fitness apps came second to none. Glad Supernatural is back. Cant wait to try the early access!

I thought this day would never get here! Thank you for making the transfer of my legacy data so simple - everything is where it should be. But most importantly, ya'll are back!!!! I'm so happy. You guys are the best.

The new supernatural health is amazing!
I love the coaches and new content. 
I really appreciate the tutorials and new scenery. Already making me laugh and smile on day one. Oh and sweat 😅 
Thank you supernatural!
Love that comeback flow workout .. Glad to see all of you again .. Man I'm sweaty now 😂😂🤣
Motivating, great music, inventive, amazing community. What more do you need?
Better than all the rest! 🎶 Yay! I have been looking forward to this day for months. Thank you to all the coaches and the people behind the scenes who made this happen! Love my Supernatural fam! 💕

I have used Supernatural for several years. It has gotten me in best shape I have been in since I wrestled in high school an college (I am now in my 70s). Thank you Supernatural for returning and continuing to keep me in shape!
So glad Supernatural is back and so am I!!!  Best workout ever.

This was a great workout! I'm so excited for new workouts and connecting with the Coaches.
So easy to get the account set up and connected to the original SN .
Thank you for not giving up and all the hard work.
So excited to jump back in!!!

Shifting from legacy to new went smoothly once i realized i needed to do some of it through my computer. Managed to transfer old data to new, then did my first new SN workout. It just plain felt good. Thank you SN team for pulling it off!

reviews.review_title: AMAZING COME BACK. WE CAN DO HARD THINGS
reviews.review_description: I am so happy with the new app. Wonderful to see everyone back and have new workouts with new choreography again. This is far and away my favorite home workout.

I had been away from AN for a while due to life catching up and when I was ready to return, I learned that the old AN was going to be leaving us. As soon as I heard we had a chance to rebuild it as a community, I had to jump at the chance! Just so happens to line up well in my life for SN's return to be right when I needed it most in my health and weight journey. 
Thank you so much, coaches and tech buddies for all this hard work to keep the best fitness app/game around!!

reviews.review_title: I missed the coaches, I missed the music
reviews.review_description:
I just missed this!!

I’m here restarting my headset cuz I got too excited and bonked a controller and messed up my workout’s last number, lol! I’ll have to redo the workout. But as Leanne says, I can do hard things!! 

So I may be sweaty, and panting, but you can’t pull that grin off my face! 

Thank you Supernatural group! ✌️🫶
Best game ever, so glad its back!

This app, the coaches, choreographers and developers are nothing short of spectacular! A SN enthusiast for about four years, it’s obvious how invested everyone is in creating a positive experience for all!   Making exercise fun is no small feat, but Supernatural makes it look easy!  Welcome back coaches, we’ve missed you!

I have had Supernatural since the legacy version, first few years. 
I love the scenes for each song, the themes, the variety of levels and types of workouts. Choreography adds so much to the fun. I love the coaches different styles, their personalities and humor.  I'm so glad the team didn't let it die.  Thank you so much!!!

reviews.review_title: Thought they would make it different
reviews.review_description:
First time trying the new platform. Not sure what I think. The workout I tried with the wands turn you around a bit to much at a time. You get no warning. And the triangles I think are way out of alignment with your body to understand what to do. 
Other than that I'm not sure if I will put out 26.00 a month Canadian

Like so many others I have been counting down days - and we made it! Supernatural is back and it's even better. I do not love the gym but THIS I love and have been able to maintain for two years. Love the flow, the music, but most of all the COACHES. Every single one is my favorite depending on the day I'm having. I truly love my S upernatural fam.

this app really makes you feel the joy of movement like nothing else that is available at this time. the coaches are so motivating that it does not feel like a chore to be moving at all. even though i am out of breath after every session i feel like going back for more until the battery runs out.

I am thrilled to have this new beginning to joyful movement! Supernatural has turned my lifelong dread of exercise into a daily -multiple times per day- ritual filled with laughter and new friends. My health and fitness have improved tremendously! I haven't missed a day in 794 days! The coaches are genuinely authentic and inspiring. The entire team behind its creation is incredible. I can't wait to see what new workouts are coming  and hope to see you in the headset!!

reviews.review_title: The only workout ever that makes me cry
reviews.review_description:
The BEST DAY EVER! 💕 RENEWAL! ✨

My heart is SO full right now! 🥹❤️

I intentionally didn’t record anything because I don’t want to spoil a single moment for anyone, but OH MY GOODNESS! I am beyond excited for the new app and everything that’s ahead for our Supernatural family!

Today’s new workout was absolutely INCREDIBLE and emotional in ways I wasn’t expecting. I honestly never thought we’d experience a brand-new move in Supernatural again, but Asia DELIVERED! 🙌🔥

And hearing NEW words of encouragement from our beloved coaches — Antonio, Leanne, Raneir, Mindy, Dwana, and Mark — was something I didn’t realize my heart needed quite so much. ❤️

There I was, moving again with pure, unfiltered JOY. A huge smile plastered across my face, tears filling my eyes at times, and that familiar feeling of being exactly where I belong.

I even took some time to sit with Coach Doc for his new meditation, and his words were exactly what I needed to hear today. His wisdom touched my heart, and I’ll be carrying those words with me. 💕

This. THIS is what it’s all about.

It’s never been just a workout. It’s the movement, the music, the encouragement, and the way it makes you FEEL. It’s finding joy in movement and remembering just how powerful that can be.

But more than anything, it’s the PEOPLE. It’s US. ❤️

This beautiful community has celebrated victories, lifted each other through difficult days, shared laughter and tears, and kept the spirit of Supernatural alive through so much uncertainty.

And today felt like coming home. 🥹❤️

To everyone who has been part of this journey, whether you’ve been here since day one or are just joining us, YOU are what makes this community so special.

Here’s to new beginnings, more magical moments, and continuing to move through life together — with joy, kindness, and love.

We’re still here. We’re still together. And the best is yet to come! 🥹🙌💕

Welcome back, Supernatural. There’s truly no place like home. ❤️✨

#SupernaturalHealth #WelcomeBack #Renewal #SupernaturalFamily

Familiar and polished, I logged in today for the resurrection of supernatural and felt like the UI was basically the same, a little brighter, a little more polished.

It’s clear the team didn’t fall into the trap of trying to get all the feature studies out for early launch.  Everything feels very good, it made me take the training again which was slightly annoying but i ma sure that could bee free men also.

Looking forward to the team collab feature as my wife prefers to work out with me. 

The core feels solid and can’t wait until ethe urologist appt.

Stay Chipper!

reviews.review_title: So glad to see you back
reviews.review_description: I’m absolutely thrilled to see Supernatural back! Transferring my old account was seamless, and the new graphics look incredibly high-def. Plus, the workouts feel even better—I'm reaching further and getting a much bigger burn. I am looking forward to see what is to come. ￼
Just finished my first workout in the new app. Is it me or is it WAY better? Either way, congrats coaches!
Quite a wide selection on Day 1. So far everything runs pretty smooth.

Absolutely thrilled to have as much of the Supernatural team back as we do, and the new app does not disappoint! I get so much out of these workouts, I'm beyond grateful it has been brought back to life!!!

reviews.review_title: Great first WO on the new app!
reviews.review_description: Fantastic graphics and music! I'm so excited it's all coming together so well. If you haven't tried it, join in! It's so worth it 👌
The one exercise I have stuck with for 3 years and counting. Especially awesome for those who want to get and keep moving.

This app really saved me and gotten me to focused on fitness and self care. No other exercise regime has ever stuck with me. Supernatural, for the last 3 years, has been part of my life. I love the accessibility, I love the music and most of all I love the coaches.

Much love to all 🖤
See you in the headset 🖤

Thanks to all who helped keep this experience going!!
Fitness has never been more fun!  Best app for any age
So happy to have this new version of the app! This is such a fun way to workout and the coaches are awesome!

reviews.review_title: So happy with the new version!!!
reviews.review_description: I have missed supernatural so much due to injury and i was so happy to be able to jump in and start using some of these new features! It has been fantastic. I for one cannot wait to see what they do once it's actually finished and ready for full release.

Supernatural has been game changing for me. It’s the only exercising that has me LOCKED IN ALL THE TIME! I’m so happy to see and experience this comeback!!! 

LETS GET IT!!
this is the only workout program i've been able to stick with. this is coming just in time for winter and i can't be more excited
My favorite cardio!! The coaches, Environments, and moves keep me coming back for more!
I have always loved this app for the last 5 years or so and I am just so glad its back!!!
So happy SN is back!!! Welcome back coaches and team! and welcome back to me!

I'm thankful, I'm proud. I'm blessed. This is a beautiful app, inside and out. Bringing back what we love, and adding some amazing extras. The whole team is back! 
Lost 110 pounds since I started and I never plan on going back.

It took a bit to figure out how to log in but got past that and it’s all good now. I was so checked out after the events earlier this year. But now, I’m excited for this relaunch and looking forward to lots of classes!
Good to see the renewed energy of all the coaches. Cant wait to see what the full release is like!

Happy to see the only workout system I have been able to stay consistent with is back!! It has always been a wonderful app. Coaches are even interactive!! Join the FB group for even more interactions. 11/10 would recommend!!
Amazing as always! Love the coaches and the content. Thank you for fighting for us SN team and all fans.
